
==  specific emotional states ==

The regular place structure is "x1 feels foo emotion about/towards x2".  Some words have extra places, noted below.

* affection: {jvsv seldirba}
* anger: {jvsv fengu} (x2 = target of anger, x3 = reason for anger)

* annoyance: {jvsv selfanza}
* anxiety: {jvsv xanka} (x2 = object of anxiety, x3 = conditions)

* awe: {jvsv manci}
* comfort: {jvsv kufra}

* curiosity: {jvsv kucli}
* desire: {jvsv djica} (x2 = desired state, x3 = purpose of desire)

* disgust: {jvsv selrigni} (x2 = disgusting matter, x3 = conditions)
* embarrassment: {jvsv burna}

* envy: {jvsv jilra} (x2 = target of envy, x3 = object/cause of envy)
* esteem: {jvsv sinma}

* fear: {jvsv terpa}
* frustration: {jvsv steba}

* guilt: {jvsv zungi}
* happiness: {jvsv gleki}

* hate: {jvsv xebni}
* hope: {jvsv pacna} (x2 = desired event, x3 = likelihood (0-1]

* interest: {jvsv selci'i}
* liking: {jvsv nelci}

* love: {jvsv prami}
* panic: {jvsv xalni}

* pity: {jvsv kecti} (x2 = target of pity, x3 = reason for pity)
* pride: {jvsv jgira}

* regret: {jvsv xenru}
* relaxation: {jvsv surla}

* sadness: {jvsv badri}
* shame: {jvsv ckeji} (x2 = conditions, x3 = community)

* shock: {jvsv seljenca}
* stress: {jvsv dunku}

* surprise: {jvsv selspaji}
* tiredness: {jvsv tatpi}
